scenarios.title: Paying the conspire cost copies the spell
decisions: A casts Burn Trail targeting player B. As an additional cost A taps both Goblin Pikers for conspire, and taps four Mountains for {3}{R}.
The conspire trigger goes on the stack and resolves: the copy targets player B.
Both players pass; the copy and then the original resolve.

variants.label: conspire_paid
variants.expected: The conspire trigger copies Burn Trail. Each deals 3 damage to B, who is at 14. The Goblin Pikers are tapped.

variants.label: conspire_not_paid
variants.delta: A does not pay the conspire cost; both Goblin Pikers stay untapped.
variants.expected: No copy is made. Burn Trail deals 3 damage to B, who is at 17.

variants.label: colors_differ
variants.delta: A controls two Grizzly Bears instead of two Goblin Pikers.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears (green) do not share a color with Burn Trail (red), so the conspire cost cannot be paid. No copy is made and B is at 17.

scenarios.title: Each instance of conspire is paid and triggers separately
decisions: A casts Burn Trail targeting player B. For its own conspire A taps two Goblin Pikers. For the conspire granted by Raiding Schemes A taps the other two. A taps four Mountains for {3}{R}.
Two conspire triggers go on the stack. Each copy targets player B.
Both players pass; the two copies and then the original resolve.

variants.label: both_paid
variants.expected: Each instance triggers on its own payment and makes one copy. Three Burn Trail resolutions deal 9 damage in total: B is at 11. All four Goblin Pikers are tapped.

variants.label: one_paid
variants.delta: A pays only one conspire instance, tapping two Goblin Pikers.
variants.expected: Only the paid instance triggers. One copy is made, two Burn Trail resolutions deal 6 damage: B is at 14. Two Goblin Pikers stay untapped.

variants.label: none_paid
variants.expected: No copies are made. Burn Trail deals 3 damage: B is at 17.

scenarios.forge_notes: Raiding Schemes grants conspire to a spell on the stack; confirm Forge offers the two conspire costs separately.
